ImageDescription.value:
Illuminated Chronicle (Page 42) - The Foundation of Saints Peter and Paul Church of Óbuda
King Saint Stephen of Hungary and Queen Gisela kneel facing each other. As a symbol of the founding of the church, they hold a miniature replica of the Church of Saints Peter and Paul in Óbuda.
